lines.name: Two cartridge bellows and axle/pinch guard set
lines.note: Complete guard material/fastener allowance only. No qualified pattern, supplier, pinch envelope or tested attachment exists. Must replace with a quoted validated design before release.

lines.name: 12 steel profiles, cutting, deburring and corrosion finish
lines.note: 20 steel pieces: eight T gussets, four axle patches, four rectangular rail shims, four spring seats. Four profile types. $4 batch increment over r1; laser/drill/finish RFQ required.

lines.name: Two stock-shaft axles, washers and cotters
lines.note: Unkeyed precision C1018 5/8 stock cut and cross-drilled. No approved supplier SKU/fit yet. No custom turned heads or threaded bearing journals.

lines.name: Cut standard steel sleeve/spacer stock
lines.note: 16x25.4 and 4x31.75 small sleeves, two 55 mm guide tubes, two axle sleeves and two wheel spacers. Cut lengths and finish included; RFQ.

lines.name: 20 grade-5 bolts, 40 washers and 20 locknuts
lines.note: 12 short and 8 long grade 5 joint bolts plus 40 washers/20 nuts. $0.50 batch increment; RFQ.

lines.name: Padded rear support, front restraint and webbing loops
lines.note: Complete textile set manufacturing allowance. No qualified supplier, support pattern, rated anchors or fit exists. This line cannot be omitted or replaced with printed supports.

lines.name: Nonstructural prints, rejects and power
lines.note: Allocated consumed material, not a full spool or printer purchase. Slicer grams/hours are unmeasured. Fixture allowance allocated, not charged as a new tool per chair.

lines.name: Cutting, drilling, cleanup and assembly labor
lines.note: 60 min at $25/h batch;3.4 h one-off. Includes slots, liner trimming, seats/pins and cartridge assembly. These times are assumptions, not a time study.

lines.name: Per-chair inspection
lines.note: Additional force/travel/friction/retention inspection allowance. Does not fund qualification tests. RFQ.

lines.name: Packaging
lines.note: Box, protection and instructions. Outbound freight separate.

lines.name: Inbound freight allocation
lines.note: Two tube SKUs plus springs and hardware. Long-stock checkout freight unverified; RFQ.

lines.name: Machine wear, shop consumables and tooling allocation
lines.note: Recurring allocation. Printer/tools/jigs and one-time development capital are budgeted separately.

lines.name: Two MISUMI SWH20-75 springs
lines.note: Two at $4.62 for 200 springs, or $5.44 for 2. Actual selected online tier, not an invented discount.

lines.name: Four smooth clevis pins with washers/cotters
lines.note: $1.25 per complete pin set batch allowance. Supplier SKU, clear grip and retention drawing not yet verified.

lines.name: 16 liner pads and two M5 guide fastener sets
lines.note: Consumed .050 inch UHMW tape, 16 pads, two M5 x 70 ISO4762 screws, DIN433 upper washers, lower washers and locknuts. No full roll charged per unit; no verified price or wear test.

evidence.name: Wurth ISO4762 M5 head dimensions
evidence.note: M5 socket head diameter 8.5 mm, height 5 mm. The linked 50 mm listing verifies the head family only; our 70 mm length and actual thread engagement require supplier confirmation.

evidence.name: DIN433 M5 reduced-OD washer
evidence.note: M5 reduced washer 9 mm OD and 5.3 mm ID, unlike the rejected oversized guide washer. Confirm 1 mm thickness and selected steel finish with supplier. In-spring head/washer/guide max OD 9.525 mm versus catalog minimum spring ID 10.1 mm, before working deflection and misalignment.

evidence.name: 6061-T6 square tube 20737, 1 x .065 inch
evidence.note: Observed 144 inch selection, $60.03. Full bars and saw kerf charged. No wholesale discount assumed.

evidence.name: HAUL-MASTER 67467 pneumatic wheel
evidence.note: Observed regular price. Nominal 13 x 4 inch, 5/8 bore, 4.7 lb each. Supplier 300 lb wheel rating does not rate the chair. Hub length and intended use remain unapproved.

evidence.name: MISUMI SWH20-75
evidence.note: Observed $5.44 each; $4.62 each at 200+. Two springs per chair: $10.88 one-off or $9.24 at 100 chairs. Batch stock/checkout/freight unconfirmed. Not a chair rating.

evidence.name: Wicks SQ1-1/4X065-T6 housing tube
evidence.note: Observed 1.25 inch square-corner 6061-T6, .065 wall, $4.20/ft. Model buys full 6-foot lengths at $25.20 each; confirm orderable stock lengths, cut tolerance and shipping. No quantity discount assumed.

evidence.name: MISUMI SWH manufacturer table
evidence.note: SWH20-75 rate 65.3 N/mm; nominal 20 mm OD/10 mm ID, 75 mm free length; table solid height 54 mm. Load tolerance +/-10%, length +/-1%. Conservative catalog deflection 14.4 mm; this is not system fatigue qualification.

evidence.name: Power Plastics .050 inch UHMW PSA wear tape
evidence.note: PSA050 family confirms .050 inch material exists. No exact-width price verified. Liner allowance is unquoted; actual adhesive thickness and corner fit must be measured.
